Mermaid 12.0.0 — third-party notices for the Notey distribution

Upstream project: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid
Release: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/releases/tag/mermaid%4012.0.0
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-12.0.0.tgz
Copyright (c) 2014 - 2022 Knut Sveidqvist
Mermaid itself is distributed under the MIT License; see LICENSE.

Notey redistributes the official minified ESM entry point and all 104 of
its static/dynamic import chunks without changing their bytes. Notey does
not ship the alternate UMD/core builds, source maps, or TypeScript files.
The official build already includes upstream patches to fastdom and
roughjs; these patches are not changes made by Notey.

LICENSES/ contains the original package license texts and applicable
notices of the included third-party code. PROVENANCE.json records exact
versions, npm archive URLs, SHA-256 and npm SHA-512 integrity values, and
source availability. VENDOR-MANIFEST.json records the shipped file hashes.
The inventory was traced from the released Mermaid and parser source maps,
the release lockfile, and the build configuration of prebundled libraries;
it is not an unfiltered development-dependency inventory.

DOMPurify is dual-licensed. This distribution uses its Apache-2.0 option;
both original upstream license files are retained for reference.
The KaTeX 0.16.47 JavaScript inside Mermaid has an MIT license and is distinct
from Notey's separately distributed KaTeX 0.18.4 CSS and font directory.

ECLIPSE SOURCE AVAILABILITY

This distribution includes elkjs 0.9.3 / Eclipse Layout Kernel code under
EPL-2.0, including code compiled from Java. Its Source Code is available
under EPL-2.0 from these upstream sources:

  elkjs 0.9.3 (wrapper, build scripts, Java emulation and published JS):
    https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/0.9.3
    https://codeload.github.com/kieler/elkjs/tar.gz/refs/tags/0.9.3

  Eclipse Layout Kernel 0.9.1:
    https://github.com/eclipse/elk/tree/v0.9.1
    https://codeload.github.com/eclipse/elk/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.9.1

  Additional ELK change included by the elkjs 0.9.3 release:
    https://github.com/eclipse/elk/pull/955
    https://patch-diff.githubusercontent.com/raw/eclipse/elk/pull/955.patch

  Upstream release identifies the ELK version and additional change:
    https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/releases/tag/0.9.3

The ELK bundle also contains GWT / Guava (Apache-2.0), Eclipse EMF for GWT
(EPL-1.0), and Xtend / Xtext runtime code (EPL-2.0). Exact Maven source-JAR
URLs and their hashes are recorded as elkCompiledLibraries in
PROVENANCE.json. Those source JARs can be downloaded using a web browser
and opened as ZIP archives. Each remains under its recorded license.
Original copyright headers and license texts are preserved in LICENSES/.
No additional Notey changes have been made to these components.

The original elk-0.9.1-NOTICE.md and gwt-2.10.0-COPYING.txt describe their
larger upstream projects. Preserving those notices does not mean that the
entire ELK desktop application, GWT SDK, its examples, or development tools
are bundled in Notey. The shipped subset is documented in PROVENANCE.json.

REDISTRIBUTION

Keep this NOTICE.txt, LICENSE, LICENSES/, PROVENANCE.json and
VENDOR-MANIFEST.json with copies of these JavaScript assets, including in
applications and generated sites. The EPL-covered components and their
Source Code retain their Eclipse licenses; Notey's MIT license does not
replace those terms. Other components retain their respective licenses.
